purpose: Use Optuna only to accelerate low-DOF discovery inside the already-authorized discovery period while retaining purged walk-forward and multiple-testing evidence.
eligible_family_rule: Only a genuinely new family with its own frozen feature/candidate contract may use this harness. Existing rejected or outcome-opened families may not be fed into it for rescue tuning.

time_policy.validation_after_selection: Freeze the selected configuration before opening later-period validation evidence.

fixed_before_search.feature_set: Supplied by a separate preregistered family spec; Optuna may not choose features.
fixed_before_search.candidate_universe: Supplied by a separate preregistered family spec.
fixed_before_search.cost_policy: All new discovery/performance metrics use transaction cost 0%. Historical 0.5%/1% outputs are legacy evidence only and may not rank candidates or determine GO/NO-GO.
fixed_before_search.entry_exit_semantics: Canonical next official XTKS session open to fifth official XTKS session close for comparable 5BD research.

search_v1.objective: Purged walk-forward out-of-sample per-active-date Sharpe of the fixed top-N cohort gross-return stream at transaction cost 0%.
search_v1.walk_forward: Date-grouped expanding walk-forward using purgedcv; label-horizon overlap must audit to zero.

multiple_testing_evidence.completed_trial_ledger_rule: Completed trials must be represented in deterministic trial-number order, hashed with SHA-256 together with frozen study metadata, and validated before the trial-Sharpe vector may be consumed by DSR.
multiple_testing_evidence.tamper_policy: Missing, extra, reordered, duplicated, modified, non-COMPLETE, or non-finite trial rows fail closed.
multiple_testing_evidence.dsr_input_binding: optuna_discovery.run_study must build the completed-trial ledger and receipt, validate them through trial_sharpes_from_receipt, and use only the returned vector for selection_bias_summary. The canonical rows and receipt must be persisted in the discovery summary.

implementation_audit_20260914_1945.finding: tvfree_screener/optuna_discovery.py still defaulted run_study/CLI round_trip_cost to 0.005 and accepted nonzero costs, while this frozen contract requires 0%. Existing synthetic test also explicitly passed 0.001.
implementation_audit_20260914_1945.fail_closed_rule: Do not run new Optuna discovery/performance until implementation defaults to 0.0, rejects any nonzero round_trip_cost, tests assert the rejection, and OSS validation CI passes.
implementation_audit_20260914_1945.required_next_action: Patch optuna_discovery.py and test_optuna_discovery.py to enforce cost0 at API and CLI boundaries; then preserve all completed-trial ledger provenance before DSR consumption.

implementation_resolution_20260914_2159.next_control: Bind DSR input to an immutable completed-trial ledger/provenance receipt so trial count and Sharpe dispersion cannot be supplied ad hoc.

promotion.rule: This contract validates research infrastructure only. A candidate still needs its own frozen family specification and locked later-period validation.
